standard_prerequisites.name: Adjunction data
standard_prerequisites.statement: A left adjoint F comes with a right adjoint G, unit eta and counit epsilon satisfying the triangle identities.
standard_prerequisites.use: Two such quadruples are compared in the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: Natural isomorphism and identity of functors
standard_prerequisites.statement: A natural isomorphism between functors in a category of functors gives an identity of the functors.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the step at source line 521.

standard_prerequisites.name: Hom-sets are sets
standard_prerequisites.statement: The hom-types of a precategory are sets.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is why the triangle identities transport automatically at source line 533.

core_obligations: Take two adjunction structures (G, eta, epsilon) and (G', eta', epsilon') and define gamma := (G' epsilon)(eta' G) and delta := (G epsilon')(eta G') (source lines 508-509).
Show delta gamma = 1_G by the displayed five-term chain, in which the interchange law and the triangle identities are used in that order (source lines 511-519).
Show gamma delta = 1_{G'} similarly, so that gamma is a natural isomorphism G ~ G', and hence an identity G = G' by the retained functor-category result (source lines 520-521).

Check that transporting eta and epsilon along that identity recovers eta' and epsilon': by the retained transport computation the transport is composition with gamma or delta, and the resulting identity for eta holds by interchange and the triangle identity (source lines 523-532).
Conclude by noting that the triangle identities themselves transport automatically because hom-sets are sets (source line 533).

proof_roadmap.step: Build the comparison isomorphisms and verify one composite.
Turn the natural isomorphism into an identity of functors.
Transport the unit and counit and dispose of the triangle identities.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.3.2 at source lines 504-506: if A is a category then the type of proofs that a functor F is a left adjoint is a mere proposition. The author's proof (source lines 507-534) is a long coherence argument rather than a citation: it manufactures the comparison natural isomorphisms gamma and delta from the two adjunction structures (lines 508-509), checks one composite against the identity through a five-term chain that consumes the interchange law and the triangle identities (lines 511-519) and the other symmetrically (line 520), converts the natural isomorphism into an identity of functors using the retained functor-category result (line 521), and then has to verify that transporting the unit and counit along that identity returns the other structure, which uses the retained transport computation and once more interchange and a triangle identity (lines 523-532); the triangle identities themselves need no work because hom-sets are sets (line 533). The statement is a propositionality claim and hides all of this.
